digest.component_or_area: review-bot receiver uvicorn logging and authentication
propositions: The review-bot /webhook and /rerun endpoints accept authentication tokens as query parameters, which uvicorn's default access log includes in plaintext request lines written to stderr/journald, exposing the shared GERRIT_BOT_TOKEN credential to any user or process reading the journal.

The webhook token is not separately configured; it defaults to GERRIT_BOT_TOKEN, so exposure of the query-string token compromises the bot's Gerrit credentials and both webhook and rerun capabilities.

Journal content flows to multiple sinks (observability scripts, log excerpts in tickets and chat, future log-shipping), widening the blast radius beyond the single container and making the secret unsafe to treat as unexposed after any incident involving shared logs.

Authentication must be moved out of the query string (via X-Rebar-Token header for /rerun and /webhook, with backward-compat for legacy query-param callers) and a TokenRedactingFilter must scrub any remaining query-string tokens from access logs to prevent reintroduction of the vulnerability.

The currently-logged GERRIT_BOT_TOKEN must be rotated after the code fix is deployed, and the rotation must be recorded explicitly rather than assumed, since the new credential will be logged on first use if the fix has not landed.
